messages:
Sanjay: heads up — after the routing config swap in prod the latency dashboard lost p95/p99 traces. legend shows p95/p99 but the chart is empty. anyone seeing this?
DeployBot: Canary deploy completed: proxy-routing-swap #452 at 1799991200 UTC.
Caroline: which dashboard link?
Sanjay: Console -> /dashboards/latency/service-latency-prod (sent link) — p50/p90 render fine, p95/p99 not drawing.
Kevin: I opened the dashboard — legend entries present but no series on the graph (white area). percentile checkboxes are on.
Liz: quick look at TSDB raw series — there are series for latency but I'm getting different label sets. can paste query if helpful.
Caroline: pls paste the grafana/console query snip.
Sanjay: ```
SELECT quantile(0.95) AS p95, quantile(0.99) AS p99
FROM request_latency
WHERE env = 'prod'
GROUP BY service
```
OpsBot: metrics-ingest reported a warning at 1799991205: "label_rename: 'quantile' -> 'q' applied to reduce cardinality" (5 occurrences).
Kevin: grepping ingest logs now — found: "renamed label 'quantile' to 'q' per collector-config v3.2" at 1799991204. Looks like the collector change landed with the routing swap.
Caroline: that would explain it — dashboard queries expect label 'quantile' while ingest now exposes 'q'. no series match so nothing draws.
Sanjay: :facepalm: so the p95/p99 series weren't deleted, just renamed to q=0.95/0.99.
Liz: workaround: update dashboard queries to use coalesce(q, quantile) or filter on both labels. long term we should add a compatibility shim.
Kevin: I'm going to patch the console query to use coalesce(q, quantile) in the dashboard template and push a hotfix.
Caroline: prefer dashboard shim first, collector rename was intentional for cardinality control. we'll avoid a revert unless necessary.
Sanjay: ok — can we do the dashboard patch as a hotfix? timeline?
Kevin: patch PR in console-config -> merged, deploying canary in ~3m.
DeployBot: Canary deploy started: console-config#879 (dashboard hotfix).
OpsBot: metrics-ingest reports no errors since 1799991210.
Liz: seeing lines reappear on my screen now — p95/p99 solid curves are back.
Sanjay: confirmed on my end too. thanks all.
Caroline: follow-up action items: 1) console to support coalesce(q,quantile) everywhere 2) notify dashboards owners about label rename3) add a short postmortem note in incidents channel.
Sanjay: I'll take the postmortem. tagging: @Caroline for collector change context.
Kevin: leaving a short rollback plan in the change ticket in case any other dashboards break.
Liz: closing loop — will scan top-20 dashboards for similar breakage.
Sanjay: thanks everyone.
